from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ROOT = Path(
    os.environ.get(
        "HERMCLAW_AGENT_WORKSPACES",
        "/home/kiworker/hermclaw_agent_workspaces",
    )
)
EXPECTED_ORIGIN = os.environ.get(
    "HERMCLAW_AGENT_REPO",
    "git@hermclaw-gitlab:local-ai/hermclaw.git",
)


class SalvageError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def _run(
    args: list[str],
    *,
    cwd: Path,
    check: bool = True,
) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        args,
        cwd=str(cwd),
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
    )
    if check and proc.returncode != 0:
        raise SalvageError(
            f"{' '.join(args)} fehlgeschlagen: "
            f"{(proc.stderr or proc.stdout).strip()}"
        )
    return proc


def _git(repo: Path, *args: str, check: bool = True) -> str:
    return _run(
        ["git", *args],
        cwd=repo,
        check=check,
    ).stdout.strip()


def _safe_job_id(job_id: str) -> str:
    value = str(job_id).strip()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,200}", value):
        raise SalvageError("Ungültige job_id.")
    return value


def find_workspace(
    job_id: str,
    workspace_root: Path = DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ROOT,
) -> tuple[Path, str]:
    job_id = _safe_job_id(job_id)
    root = workspace_root.resolve()
    if not root.exists() or not root.is_dir():
        raise SalvageError(
            f"Workspace-Root fehlt: {root}"
        )

    matches: list[tuple[Path, str]] = []
    for candidate in root.iterdir():
        if not candidate.is_dir():
            continue
        git_dir = candidate / ".git"
        if not git_dir.exists():
            continue

        branch = _git(
            candidate,
            "branch",
            "--show-current",
            check=False,
        )
        if (
            branch.startswith("ai/job-")
            and job_id in branch
        ):
            matches.append((candidate.resolve(), branch))

    if not matches:
        raise SalvageError(
            f"Kein isolierter Workspace für Job {job_id} gefunden."
        )
    if len(matches) > 1:
        rendered = ", ".join(
            str(path) for path, _ in matches
        )
        raise SalvageError(
            "Mehrere passende Workspaces gefunden; "
            f"Salvage wird aus Sicherheitsgründen abgebrochen: {rendered}"
        )
    return matches[0]


def salvage(
    job_id: str,
    *,
    workspace_root: Path = DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ROOT,
    expected_origin: str = EXPECTED_ORIGIN,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    repo, branch = find_workspace(
        job_id,
        workspace_root,
    )

    origin = _git(
        repo,
        "remote",
        "get-url",
        "origin",
    )
    if origin != expected_origin:
        raise SalvageError(
            "Unerwartetes Git-Origin; Salvage wird verweigert: "
            f"{origin}"
        )

    status_before = _git(
        repo,
        "status",
        "--porcelain=v1",
        "--untracked-files=all",
    )
    head_before = _git(
        repo,
        "rev-parse",
        "HEAD",
    )

    committed = False
    if status_before:
        _git(repo, "add", "-A")
        staged = _git(
            repo,
            "diff",
            "--cached",
            "--name-only",
        )
        if staged:
            _run(
                [
                    "git",
                    "-c",
                    "user.name=Hermclaw Runtime",
                    "-c",
                    "user.email=runtime@hermclaw.local",
                    "commit",
                    "-m",
                    (
                        "Runtime salvage after bounded "
                        f"agent round limit ({job_id})"
                    ),
                ],
                cwd=repo,
            )
            committed = True

    head_after = _git(
        repo,
        "rev-parse",
        "HEAD",
    )

    if not committed and head_after == head_before:
        # A previous runtime step may already have committed but not pushed.
        remote_head = _git(
            repo,
            "ls-remote",
            "--heads",
            "origin",
            branch,
            check=False,
        )
        if remote_head:
            remote_sha = remote_head.split()[0]
            if remote_sha == head_after:
                raise SalvageError(
                    "Workspace hat keine ungesicherten Änderungen "
                    "und Branch ist bereits vollständig gepusht."
                )

    _git(
        repo,
        "push",
        "-u",
        "origin",
        branch,
    )

    changed_files = [
        line.strip()
        for line in _git(
            repo,
            "show",
            "--pretty=",
            "--name-only",
            "HEAD",
        ).splitlines()
        if line.strip()
    ]

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "job_id": job_id,
        "branch": branch,
        "workspace": str(repo),
        "head": head_after,
        "salvaged": True,
        "committed_during_salvage": committed,
        "changed_files": changed_files,
        "result": "runtime-salvage-after-round-limit",
    }


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "Sichert einen fehlgeschlagenen Hermclaw-Workspace "
            "nach einem kontrollierten Rundenlimit."
        )
    )
    parser.add_argument("--job-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--workspace-root",
        default=str(DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ROOT),
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--expected-origin",
        default=EXPECTED_ORIGIN,
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    result = salvage(
        args.job_id,
        workspace_root=Path(args.workspace_root),
        expected_origin=args.expected_origin,
    )
    Path(args.output).write_text(
        json.dumps(
            result,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    print(
        "[SALVAGE] Kontrolliertes Rundenlimit: "
        "Workspace gesichert."
    )
    print(
        f"[SALVAGE] branch: {result['branch']}"
    )
    print(
        f"[SALVAGE] head: {result['head'][:12]}"
    )
    print(
        f"[SALVAGE] Ergebnis: {args.output}"
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from model_runtime.salvage_agent_workspace import salvage


def git(cwd: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args],
        cwd=str(cwd),
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=True,
    )
    return proc.stdout.strip()


class SalvageAgentWorkspaceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_salvages_dirty_matching_workspace(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            base = Path(tmp)
            remote = base / "remote.git"
            workspaces = base / "workspaces"
            workspaces.mkdir()
            repo = workspaces / "job-workspace"

            git(base, "init", "--bare", str(remote))
            git(base, "clone", str(remote), str(repo))
            git(repo, "config", "user.name", "Test")
            git(repo, "config", "user.email", "test@example.invalid")

            (repo / "a.txt").write_text(
                "base\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            git(repo, "add", "a.txt")
            git(repo, "commit", "-m", "base")
            git(repo, "push", "-u", "origin", "HEAD:main")

            job_id = "routing-v02-main-test-i0-123"
            branch = f"ai/job-{job_id}-main-coder"
            git(repo, "checkout", "-b", branch)
            (repo / "a.txt").write_text(
                "changed\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            result = salvage(
                job_id,
                workspace_root=workspaces,
                expected_origin=str(remote),
            )

            self.assertTrue(result["salvaged"])
            self.assertEqual(result["branch"], branch)
            self.assertTrue(
                result["committed_during_salvage"]
            )
            remote_head = git(
                repo,
                "ls-remote",
                "--heads",
                "origin",
                branch,
            )
            self.assertIn(result["head"], remote_head)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
